note: The chat-app track of Answers Over Time: the owner asks each app BY HAND and imports the replies from a file (cli archive-chatbot-template, cli archive-chatbot-import). No software ever contacts these apps. The questions below are this track's own list: it is not linked to archive_questions.json or archive_trending.json. Every prompt is prompt_prefix, a blank line, then the question. Until the first real import the list may be changed; after it a recorded question never changes or disappears and new ones are appended. No politics (a crude word check refuses obvious ones). `human` words the column of answers written by people, which the owner collects by hand. `aside` is one line of the owner's own, shown once on the chat-app method page and never on a card; it is a joke, not a claim. Names are used only to say which app was asked; this project is not affiliated with their makers.
